name: Trade war & tariffs
value: Rare-earth pause ends 10 Nov; no notice found
summary: China's rare-earth control pause ends 10 Nov with no notice found; US extended its Affiliates Rule pause to 10 Jan 2027
state: China's one-year suspension of its October 2025 rare-earth export controls ends on 10 Nov unless new legal text appears (Environment + Energy Leader). No notice had been published as of 5 Nov (Motley Fool), and searches on 9 Nov found none. China's commerce ministry extended the wider truce to 10 Jan 2027 on 28 Sep without naming rare earths. The US formally extended its own Affiliates Rule suspension to 10 Jan 2027 in a notice published on 9 Nov (Nixon Peabody).
for_you: Manufacturers using rare-earth magnets and components may see licensing delays if the controls return on 11 Nov. Any change would first appear in official notices from China's commerce ministry.
rubric_hit: Watch: major controls between large economies may resume on 11 Nov absent a notice; no broad new tariffs with retaliation found
